name: Lasagne
notes: From Clovis friend, Dale. We used to do dinner exchanges, and this was one of our favorites! Dale also taught me how to kindly tell a child to “run along” when it was time to quit interrupting grown-up conversation and get back to playing. I usually double this recipe and freeze one for later. It makes too many dirty dishes for just one dinner. Besides, one of these in the freezer is WAY better than a frozen lasagne from the store! If you refrigerate or freeze the casserole, don’t top it directly with foil, as the tomato sauce will corrode the foil. Put a layer of wax paper in between. Keto variation: use dried zucchini succeed instead of pasta, but be sure to bake a full hour.

items: 1 pound ground beef (or bulk Italian sausage)
16 oz can tomatoes, cut up, undrained
2½ cups ricotta cheese or cream-style cottage cheese

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Saute until done: **1 pound ground beef** (or bulk Italian sausage), **½ cup chopped onion** and **1 clove garlic, minced** (add in last 1-2 minutes).

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Drain off fat, then add and simmer, covered, about 15 minutes: **16 oz can tomatoes, cut up, undrained**, **8 oz tomato sauce**, **6 oz tomato puree**, **2 tsp dried basil, crushed** and **1 tsp salt**.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: Meanwhile, cook til al dente, then drain: **8 oz lasagne noodles** and **1 Tbsp cooking oil**.

steps.title: Mix the cheese filling
steps.body: In a separate bowl, mix together: **2 eggs**, **2½ cups ricotta cheese or cream-style cottage cheese**, **½ cup grated parmesan** and **2 Tbsp dried parsley flakes**.

steps.title: Prepare the toppings
steps.body: Prepare and set aside: **1 lb mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced** and **¼ cup grated parmesan**.

steps.title: Layer
steps.body: Oil a 10×12×2 pan, then layer half the noodles, spread half the ricotta cheese mixture, then half the mozzarella cheese, and top with half the meat sauce. Repeat. Sprinkle remaining parmesan cheese atop.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 375°F for 30-35 minutes, or until heated through, longer if refrigerated before.
